I texted the tenant to ask what the problem is, where it is, when it happened before, who fixed it and for a photo. The text also covers what to do in an emergency. The ticket is on hold until tomorrow and stays at intake until we know what the problem is.

Only the tenant can answer quickly, so asking them is the right step. classify_reply flagged the message for review (needs a human response 0.87, dissatisfied 0.93). That is covered by a personal reply asking for the missing details.
